name: cosmetic
description: Cosmetic changes: typography, spacing, colors, alignment

prompts.prompt: Improve the typography for better print readability. Increase font sizes for headings, add more line-height to body text, and ensure consistent spacing between sections.
prompts.expectedBehavior: Font sizes and spacing should change, structure should remain

prompts.prompt: Convert all colors to a grayscale scheme suitable for black and white printing. Replace colored backgrounds with subtle gray tones and ensure sufficient contrast for text.
prompts.expectedBehavior: Colors should change to grayscale, structure preserved

prompts.prompt: Add generous margins and padding suitable for printed documents. Ensure text doesn't touch edges and sections have clear visual separation.
prompts.expectedBehavior: Margins and padding values change, elements remain

prompts.prompt: Center-align all heading elements (h1, h2, h3, etc.) while keeping body text left-aligned.
Add subtle 1px solid gray borders around major sections to create visual separation. Don't add borders to inline elements.
